name: Content Preview API access token
description: A Preview API access token, available on the same page as the Delivery API token, used against the preview host.

blockers.summary: The pages read state no prefix, alphabet or length for the value; only a provider statement would.
A real value's shape, and whether it differs by role or era, would need an issued credential.
